text: Two new levels below Beginner for people who have just learnt the moves, and the app asks your level on first launch. Practice and challenge modes: challenge games count towards your rating, with no hints or take-backs. Review a finished game by dragging along a graph of how it went, with the engine's move at every step and each move judged from best to blunder. Endgame practice has 30 studies from the classical manuals, mates in 2 to 12. English interface with WXF notation.
新增新手、入门两档，适合刚学会走棋的人；第一次打开会先问你的水平。分练习与挑战两种模式：挑战计入积分，不能提示和悔棋。下完一局可以复盘：棋盘下方是整局的形势走势图，手指拖动就能逐步回看，每一步都画出引擎推荐的走法，并评为最佳、缓着、失误或败着。残局练习换成 30 道古谱原局，2 到 12 步杀，解不出可以看答案。新增英文界面。形势分默认隐藏，可在「更多」里打开。
